scripts.check:release: npm run typecheck --workspace @reboil/store && npm test --workspace @reboil/store && npm run check:skills && npm run check:package && npm run check:docs
scripts.check:workspaces: npm run build --workspaces --if-present && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.check:docs: npm run verify:agents --prefix docs-site && npm run typecheck --prefix docs-site && npm run build --prefix docs-site
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run check:workspaces && npm test && npm run test:pr-title && npm run check:skills && npm run check:package
scripts.check:all: npm run check && npm run check:docs
